title: QBox platform description
description: v0.1 draft. Single source of truth for a QBox virtual platform; the Lua configuration is generated from it.

schemaVersion.description: 0.2 adds subsystems (modules with "modules"); a 0.1 file is a valid 0.2 file unchanged.

luaPrelude.description: Lua files run with dofile() before variables are defined. ${TOP} is the directory of the generated config.

variables.description: Named constants, emitted in order. Later entries may reference earlier ones.

luaIncludes.description: Lua files run with dofile() after variables are defined (for example a bootloader blob that reads the load addresses).

modules.description: Module instances keyed by instance name. Emitted in the order written.

debug.description: Debugger hints. Not written to the Lua configuration.

symbols.description: ELF files with debug symbols for the target software, for example vmlinux when the kernel is loaded as a raw binary.

luaAppend.description: Escape hatch: Lua files appended verbatim after the generated platform table.

devicetree.description: Device tree generated from this platform (VP Studio: Generate Device Tree). Addresses and interrupts come from the modules and their connections.

output.description: DTB file to write, ${TOP}-relative or absolute, e.g. "${TOP}fw/Artifacts/generated.dtb". When set, Start Simulation regenerates it first (needs dtc), and a loader entry should load it.

model.description: Root model property. Default: the platform name.

stdout.description: Instance of the console UART (chosen/stdout-path). Default: the first PL011.

initrd.description: Loader entry holding the initrd ({module, entry} with entry the index in entries), or false for none. Default: the bin_file entry whose name contains initrd or initramfs.

extra.description: DTS text added at the end of the root node, for nodes the generator does not produce.

hex.description: Unsigned integer as a hex string. Addresses and sizes are strings because JSON numbers lose precision above 2^53.

varRef.description: Reference to a variable, optionally plus or minus a constant: ${NAME}, ${NAME}+0x1000, ${NAME}-4.

templateString.description: Free text. ${TOP} expands to the config directory, ${NAME} to a variable, {i} to the replica index inside a replicated module or port.

luaExpr.description: Escape hatch: a raw Lua expression emitted verbatim. Inside a replicated module the index is available as i. The graphical editor shows these as opaque.

params.description: CCI parameters and other plain keys of a module, keyed by the name QBox expects.

global.description: Emit as a Lua global instead of a local. Needed when an included Lua file reads it.

overridable.description: Emit as: if NAME == nil then NAME = value end. Lets the launcher preset it. Implies global.

hostPort.description: The value is a TCP port on the host (for example a QEMU hostfwd port). When it is taken, the launcher starts the simulation with a free port instead. Implies overridable.

bindTarget.description: instance.port of the peer, without the leading &. May contain {i}. Inside a subsystem, the instance is looked up in its container first, then outward; "periph.uart_0.irq" reaches into a nested container.

port.description: A TLM socket or signal port. With address and size it is a memory-mapped target socket.

relative_addresses.description: For a target bound to a bus with an address: false passes the address on unchanged; true (the default) passes it relative to this target's address (QBox's router and at_bus). A bus behind another bus that decodes the same absolute addresses needs false.

repeat.description: Emit this port N times; {i} in the port name and in bind runs from 0 to N-1.

type.description: QBox moduletype, as listed in the component catalog.

args.description: Constructor arguments in order. {"ref": "name"} is a reference to another instance; a string is passed as is.

dylib.description: dylib_path for modules loaded from a shared library, without .so (QBox adds it). A library name, or a path; ${TOP} stands for the folder of the generated Lua (a model built with the modeling wizard, for example "${TOP}../models/my_timer/build/my_timer").

count.description: Replicate this module N times as name_0 .. name_N-1. {i} is the replica index.

perIndex.description: Overrides for single replicas, keyed by index. Merged over params and ports.

entries.description: Positional sub-tables, such as the images of a loader.

devicetree.description: How this module appears in the generated device tree: false leaves it out; an object describes a module type the generator does not know, or adds properties.

compatible.description: Makes a node for this module: reg from its bus-mapped ports, interrupts from its connections to the interrupt controller.

properties.description: Extra properties: true for an empty one, a string or string list, or numbers (cells).

modules.description: Makes this module a subsystem (container) holding these modules; use it with type "Container". Inside, a name in a bind or args is looked up in this container first, then in each enclosing one; a dotted name ("periph.uart_0") reaches into a nested container. A container has no count and no ports of its own.
